name: nop-lint
description: YAML-driven AST lint system on the pure-Java tree-sitter runtime (nop-treesitter). ast-grep-style pattern matching (SourcePatternCompiler, NOT TSQuery extension), XLang xscript dynamic checks with deadline executor (global-executor route, zero platform change), XDSL/xdef-based YAML rule loading, L1-L4 type inference reusing nop-java-parser + nop-ai-code-analyzer, fast/standard/deep profiles. Roadmap: ai-dev/backlog/nop-lint-roadmap.md. Design: ai-dev/design/nop-lint/. Modules: nop-lint-core/-java/-js/-nop (+maven-plugin/graphql/cli in Wave 6). Hard constraints: TSQuery frozen; no modifications to existing nop-treesitter classes; nop-xlang/nop-core are Protected Areas (plan-first) - deadline route A first; every rule lands with RuleTester fixtures.
